pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal regions with highly serrated, star-like edge gradients. Patch spatial area is significantly larger on the neck region, transitioning to smaller, more condensed geometries on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light tan interstitial pathways forming a complex topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-point intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform throughout the mid-section, narrowing slightly between smaller posterior patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dark, fringed silhouette visible along the dorsal line of the neck. The 1D contour exhibits low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations against the background.
